limitations: Research engine reanalysis only; no Semctx product reindex claim or ranking.
Cold means no previous engine index in fresh scratch; OS caches are not flushed.
T/Y parse exactly selected files. S/L additionally load the Cargo workspace and configured sysroot.
T old-tree incremental parse; Y separate full parses; S two full batch processes; L one persistent server per pair.
PSAPI direct-child peak working set, no descendant aggregation. L also reports its server peak separately.
Native parse time and process wall time are distinct.
NONCONFORMING_WINDOWS_SCIP_PATHS: diagnostic matching only; native SCIP remains non-portable, without conformance or production admission.
Windows native SCIP relative paths are NONCONFORMING to the official protocol; explicit windows-diagnostic matching only, original bytes retained.
SCIP protobufjs diagnostic decoder ignores unknown fields; no complete decoder or native CLI JSON equivalence guarantee.
Y binary built against 450 source and transferred via sixteen identical Y/fixture input hashes; actual experiment source is A3.
Input/runtime hashes cover declared trusted local scope; no full OS DLL/stdlib sandbox or hostile-input guarantee.
